selection_timing: created BEFORE any Gen-4 case content was authored (§8)

profile_requirement.finding: AcceptanceProfileV2 does NOT enumerate holdout capability families; it requires that the sealed holdout set consists of distinct case families each representing a required product capability, with ALL families meeting the >= 2/3 repetition floor (functional_case_outcome.truth_based_floor.population)
profile_requirement.therefore: §8 branch 2 applies: a capability selection record is required before authoring

permitted_basis: TraceLens product requirements: the product investigates seized-device evidence for fraud/insider-risk cases; acceptance certifies capabilities across the forensic risk taxonomy, not a single scenario
forensic risk taxonomy: financial-crime typologies (fund flow analysis) and insider-risk typologies (bulk data staging) are top-tier casework categories in digital forensics

AcceptanceProfile semantics: each family must be a DISTINCT required product capability; the frozen negative-case gates (identity/temporal/no-evidence/misleading-context) are evaluator-side case-level gates, not family selectors

forbidden_basis_check.premature_closure_targeted: §9 compliance: neither family is a no-evidence or premature-closure construct; both families present rich positive evidence worlds with plain facts to establish
forbidden_basis_check.generation_reuse: §7 compliance: no Gen-1 refund/vpn, Gen-2 attribution/refutation, or Gen-3 ledger/failover story, entity, timestamp, filename, or evidence layout is reused or lightly reskinned

selected_families.product_rationale: multi-hop fund dispersion (layering/money-mule topology) reconstruction is a required anti-fraud forensic capability: the analyst must establish the observable transfer pattern as fact, discriminate benign personal transfers inside the same records, and refuse to assert criminal source or intent beyond the records
selected_families.distinct_from_prior_generations: Gen-1 refund-fraud was a single victim-to-merchant scripted refund flow; this family is a multi-account, multi-hop dispersion topology with an aggregation endpoint and benign counter-examples inside one statement record; no story, entity, or artifact overlaps
selected_families.negative_risk_axes_exercised: intent overclaim (criminalizing holders), benign-transaction misclassification, source-of-funds overclaim

selected_families.product_rationale: pre-departure bulk file staging vs authorized backup discrimination is a required insider-risk capability: the analyst must establish the observable copy operation and its scope as fact, assess it against frozen authorization records, and refuse to assert completed exfiltration or theft intent
selected_families.distinct_from_prior_generations: Gen-2 attribution-contradiction and Gen-3 ledger-identity asked WHO an action belongs to; this family deliberately does not ask who — it asks WHAT operation occurred, its SCOPE against authorization records, and whether third-party transfer is established; no story, entity, or artifact overlaps
selected_families.negative_risk_axes_exercised: theft-intent overclaim, completed-exfiltration overclaim, overgeneralizing authorized actions as violations

decision: holdout set = 2 new families (fund_flow_layering, bulk_staging_discrimination), one case each, brand-new instances; per-family qualifying floor stays the frozen >= 2/3
